data.long_meaning: The name Hafa is derived from the Arabic word 'hafa' meaning gentle wind or soft breeze. This name is reminiscent of the tranquility and peace that comes with a gentle breeze. The name Hafa carries the meaning “Gentle Wind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hafa usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle wind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the name Hafa is said to symbolize the gentle breath of Allah, reminding us of His presence and mercy.
data.etymology: Hafa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle Wind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hafa total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
